Elements__Meta.Meta__Description: Hand-drawn vectors on the plan: section marks, door swing corrections, hatch boundaries, the demolition overlay. A hatch is published as its FILL RULE and its boundary, not as a thousand little lines - the reader paints an SVG pattern, which is one paint whatever the area.
Elements__Meta.Meta__ExampleNote: DUMMY DATA. Two of the hundred and fifty-nine are written out.

Shape__Hatch.Hatch__Note: The pattern tile is published ONCE PER PROJECT as its own small SVG and referenced by every shape on every document that uses it, so a plan with forty hatched walls downloads one tile and a second plan downloads none. A path beginning with a slash is relative to the PUBLISHED DOCUMENTS ROOT, not to this document's folder - that is the only shape a shared asset takes. The reader makes an SVG <pattern> from the tile and fills the boundary: one paint per shape, whatever the area.
